description: Land Title Settlement Department - Katiyawa, Thalawa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110109
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, village locations, and ownership details. The content focuses on land registration, title determinations, and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
